info.name: NPIS Registration & Organizer Management API
info.description: Nigeria Police Intelligence Summit (NPIS) API v1. Import against {{baseUrl}} = http://localhost:8000/api/v1. Every JSON success response uses the shared HttpResponse envelope {status, message, data}. Participant photos, certificates, exports and brochures are stored in Cloudinary with ImageKit fallback; signed media URLs proxy those cloud objects. Errors use {status:false, message, data:{code, details, requestId}}. Participant endpoints require a two-hour session from verification. Organizer endpoints require an access grant then an OIDC organizer session. Idempotent operations require Idempotency-Key; itinerary and accommodation updates require If-Match.
